thought.text: All distribution components are present. Now deploy per the guide:

reasoning_content:
The distribution zip contains all the components listed in the guide:
- bin: xplan-cli.zip, xplan-validator-executor.jar ✓
- conf: all the workspace zips, config zips, mapserver/mapproxy/ldproxy config, database scripts ✓
- doc: user manual HTML+PDF, operational manual HTML+PDF ✓
- web: all WARs ✓

Note: In the guide, webpages is described as "xplan-webpages.war" — it exists ✓. All the WARs are present.

Alright, now let's deploy following the guide:
1. Extract the workspace zips to DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/opt/deegree
2. Extract the config zips to XPLANBOX_CONFIG=/opt/xplanbox/xplan-manager-config
3. Copy the WARs to the webapps of the 3 Tomcats
4. Create webapps.properties
5. Configure the DB connection in the xplan.xml files
6. Start everything up in order: DB (running), RabbitMQ (running), MapServer, Tomcats, (MapProxy optional)

Let's start with the deployment.

action.command:
cd /tmp/dist
# 1) deegree workspaces -> DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT
for z in xplan-manager-workspace.zip xplan-services-wfs-workspace.zip xplan-services-wfs-syn-workspace.zip xplan-services-wms-workspace.zip xplan-validator-workspace.zip xplan-webservices-validator-wms-workspace.zip xplan-webservices-inspireplu-workspace.zip; do
  python3 -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('conf/$z').extractall('/opt/deegree')" || echo "FAILED $z"
done
ls /opt/deegree
